text: Agile methodology is a modern way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at once, teams work in short cycles called sprints, usually lasting two to four weeks. Before each sprint, the team chooses tasks from a prioritized list called the backlog, which contains user stories describing what users need. Every day, team members hold short meetings called standups to share progress and discuss problems. This iterative development approach allows teams to improve the product step by step and respond quickly to changes. As a result, Agile helps teams deliver useful software faster and keep customers satisfied.
